cells.gaps: KCB Group and Equity Bank are connected to PAPSS (KEN-007) and PesaLink receives inbound payments through it (November 2026, KEN-008), but no source found says Kenyan banks or payment providers send payments through PAPSS; question 4 asks for send and receive.
cells.note: The CBK licenses payment service providers (41 in its November 2025 directory) and regulates Kenswitch, a domestic switch connecting banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers, so stage 4. PAPSS payments into Kenya arrive through PesaLink, but none is reported going out, so not 5.
